payload.text: ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6, on vc's orders: a six-bank train applied in order on main, cc's refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (patch-id 4ae2585f7479) and wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d), then ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (blob a10e09b24211, patch-id 8126a568631b), then cc's wp04b-init-v1 (e8aee9ac86d6) and wp04b-ats-v1 (f649be3fa3ea), then ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/pipeline-cell-width-v4 (blob f2dc986d8c7c, patch-id e058514c0734). All six applied in order on main c664ea126 on 2026-10-27 (ic's temp-index measurement, tree 00c92522e4c3), and cc's scratch tip e22661b78 is the six over main 5d9b5e2be, the base the next train stacks on (0657 v2, ST0081 WP-02, 0658 v1). Page v2: each lane lists its queued asks under its holders (`lanes[].queue`), and a controller.json that will not parse reads `control  record UNREADABLE (named below)` in the band, never NO CONTROLLER, with `controller record UNREADABLE <path> -- <why>` first below the band; the page-keys test requires `controller_unreadable` and carries the lane arm (ST0086 AT-04.6). Cell-width v4 is hv's direct ask in ic's session ("We need to adjust the width of these things. That's bonkers."): `.cell` is `flex: 0 0 18rem; min-width: 0`, `.what` clamps at four lines and `.meta` at two, CSS only in shell.html, no CHANGELOG hunk; v1 to v3 are superseded. The judge runs when molt-vc closes L1 and grants Intent's slot (Intent is L2 in hv's layer order, molt-vc decision 22); its render leg runs ic's render tools v3 (refs/bank/ic/tools/render-states.sh 96c9f5840582, prelude.js 942b1e87c794). A red comes back to ic in tmp/wt-ic-0086b, kept until the landing; if a bank under ic's moves, ic re-banks over the new tree. After build all, ic looks at the cards on the live page. No claim: the work package is cc's. No push, no release.
